attack_techniques: Remote Services: Direct Cloud VM Connections (T1021.008)
attackers_goals: Utilize direct access to virtual infrastructure to pivot through a cloud environment.
description: An identity connected to a compute instance using serial console access. This may indicate an attacker attempting to move laterally between cloud instances.
investigative_actions: Verify whether the identity should be making this action. Investigate which actions were performed via serial console access.
